summary: [para 15] 15. Accordingly, the Petitioner is currently in the process of finalising suitable candidates for the appointment of Managing Director and Independent Directors. However, considering the fact that the Petitioner is relatively a new entity in the evolving Indian power sector, particularly the power exchange space, attracting the right senior professionals for the role of Managing Director is taking longer than what would normally be required. Therefore, the said process has taken more time. [para 16] 16. In view of the above, the petitioner requested another three-month extension for the appointment of Managing Director from 31.03.2024. The petitioner was hopeful of having the required number of Independent Directors and the Managing Director by the said extended time. [para 20] 20. The order in the matter which was reserved on 08.05.2024 could not be issued as the Members of the Commission who formed part of the Coram, demitted office. Accordingly, the matter was re-listed for hearing. [para 28] 28. The Petitioner has already filed Petition No. 291/RC/2024 on 02.08.2024, wherein the Petitioner has submitted two names for the vacancy of Independent Director for approval of the Commission. [para 32] 32. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submitted that the Petitioner had filed an affidavit dated 07.03.2025 in compliance with the Commission’s directions, vide Record of Proceedings for the hearing dated 04.03.2025. A detailed offer letter was issued on 10.02.2025 to the selected candidate, Mr. Harish Saran, for the position of Managing Director. The selection process was in accordance with the Commission's order dated 12.05.2021, amended Articles of Association, and Companies Act 2013. [para 35] 35. The petitioner, HPX, filed petition 148/MP/2024 on 28.03.2024 to seek additional time of 3 months in order to meet the compliances as set out in Regulation 17 of PMR 2021, i.e., the appointment of Independent Directors and Managing Director. [para 39] 39. During the hearing on 04.03.2025, the petitioner informed that the Managing Director post would be offered to Mr. Harish Saran, currently serving a leadership role in PTC India Limited, in spite of specific directions given vide order dated 12.05.2021 in petition no. 287/MP/2018. As per clause 42 of the order in petition no. 287/MP/2018, the Commission had directed: [¶] CERC website S. No. 421/2025 Order in Petition No. 148/MP/2024 Page **19** of **19**
title: Petition under Section 66 of the Electricity Act read with Regulation 17(12), 54, 55, and 56 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Power Market) Regulations, 2021 seeking additional time period for meeting the compliances as set out under Regulation 17 of the said Regulations.
